source.text: Τῇ δὲ πρώτῃ τῶν ἀζύμων προσῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες· Ποῦ θέλεις ἑτοιμάσωμέν σοι φαγεῖν τὸ πάσχα;

records.literal_gloss: On the and first of the unleavened [bread] came the disciples to the Jesus saying, Where do you want we prepare for you to eat the Passover?

en.L: Now on the first [day] of Unleavened Bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, "Where do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want us to prepare for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to eat the Passover?"
en.B: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Where would {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} like us to get the Passover meal ready for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?"
en.R: On the first day of the Festival of Bread Without Yeast, the followers came to Jesus. They asked, "Where do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want us to get the Passover meal ready for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?"

es.L: Y el primer [día] de los Ázimos se acercaron los discípulos a Jesús, diciendo: «¿Dónde quieres que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} preparemos para comer la Pascua?».
es.B: El primer día de la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura, los discípulos se acercaron a Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron: «¿Dónde quieres que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} preparemos la cena de la Pascua?».
es.R: El primer día de la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura, los seguidores fueron a ver a Jesús. Le preguntaron: «¿Dónde quieres que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} preparemos la cena de la Pascua?».

sw.L: Basi siku ya kwanza ya [Mikate] Isiyotiwa Chachu wanafunzi walimwendea Yesu, wakisema, "Wapi unapenda tukuandalie [mahali] ili ule Pasaka?"
sw.B: Siku ya kwanza ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, wanafunzi walimjia Yesu, wakamwuliza, "Ungependa tukuandalie chakula cha Pasaka mahali gani?"
sw.R: Siku ya kwanza ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, wanafunzi walimwendea Yesu. Wakamwuliza, "Unataka tukutayarishie chakula cha Pasaka wapi?"

decisions.choice: the first day of Unleavened Bread: the day the Passover lambs were killed
alternatives: the day after the Passover meal
decisions.reason: Strictly the feast began on the fifteenth of Nisan, but the day the lambs were killed, the fourteenth, was counted with it (Mark 14:12). All yeast was removed from homes that day (Exodus 12:15-20).

decisions.choice: to eat the Passover: the meal of lamb, unleavened bread and bitter herbs
decisions.reason: The Passover was eaten at night in Jerusalem (Exodus 12:8; Deuteronomy 16:5-7). A room and food had to be made ready.

decisions.choice: Bread Without Yeast
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name of the feast.

decisions.choice: the Passover meal
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the meal is meant.

decisions.choice: los Ázimos (L); la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura (B, R)
alternatives: la fiesta del Pan sin Levadura
decisions.reason: The Greek names the feast by its bread alone, "the unleavened" (meaning decision m1). "Ázimo" is the Spanish word for unleavened bread and keeps that short name at Literal, but few readers know it, so Balanced and Readable spell the name out.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on separate pronouns only (te, le, me, mí, mi)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: "Quieres" carries "you" in the verb and a pronoun joined to a verb takes no span, so the setting covers fewer words than in English. The same through the passage.

decisions.choice: [Mikate] Isiyotiwa Chachu (L); Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "the unleavened" (meaning decision m1). "Chachu" is the everyday word for yeast or leaven, so "Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu" (bread with no yeast put in) is clear at every level, and Readable needs no other wording. Swahili carries "you" in the verbs here, so there is no deity_pronoun span in this verse.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν πόλιν πρὸς τὸν δεῖνα καὶ εἴπατε αὐτῷ· Ὁ διδάσκαλος λέγει· Ὁ καιρός μου ἐγγύς ἐστιν· πρὸς σὲ ποιῶ τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου.

records.literal_gloss: He and said, Go into the city to such a one and say to him, The teacher says, The time of me near is; with you I do the Passover with the disciples of me.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Go into the city to a certain man and say to him, 'The Teacher says: My time is near; at your [house] I am keeping the Passover with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} disciples.'"
en.B: He told them, "Go into the city to a certain man and tell him, 'The Teacher says: My appointed time is near. I will celebrate the Passover at your house with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} disciples.'"
en.R: Jesus answered, "Go into the city to a certain man. Say to him, 'The Teacher says: The time God has set for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} is near. I will eat the Passover meal at your house with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} followers.'"

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a la ciudad, a [ver a] cierto hombre, y {{plural_you:díganle|decidle}}: “El Maestro dice: Mi tiempo está cerca; en tu [casa] celebro la Pascua con {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} discípulos”».
es.B: Él les respondió: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a la ciudad, a casa de cierto hombre, y {{plural_you:díganle|decidle}}: “El Maestro dice: Mi tiempo señalado está cerca. Voy a celebrar la Pascua en tu casa con {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} discípulos”».
es.R: Jesús les contestó: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a la ciudad, a casa de cierto hombre. {{plural_you:Díganle|Decidle}}: “El Maestro dice: Ya se acerca el tiempo que Dios {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha señalado. Voy a comer la cena de la Pascua en tu casa con {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} seguidores”».

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Nendeni mjini kwa mtu fulani, mkamwambie, 'Mwalimu anasema: Wakati {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} umekaribia; nyumbani kwako ninaadhimisha Pasaka pamoja na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.'"
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Nendeni mjini kwa mtu fulani, mkamwambie, 'Mwalimu anasema hivi: Wakati {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} niliowekewa umekaribia. Nitaiadhimisha Pasaka nyumbani kwako pamoja na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.'"
sw.R: Yesu akajibu, "Nendeni mjini kwa mtu fulani. Mwambieni, 'Mwalimu anasema: Wakati ambao Mungu ameniwekea umekaribia. Nitakula chakula cha Pasaka nyumbani kwako pamoja na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.'"

decisions.choice: a certain man: someone Matthew does not name
decisions.reason: The word is used of a person one does not name. He seems to know "the Teacher", so the meal may have been arranged beforehand.

decisions.choice: my time: the time God has appointed for Jesus's death
decisions.reason: The word means a fixed or fitting time. Jesus has just spoken of being handed over (26:2); compare "the hour" in 26:45.

decisions.choice: The time God has set for me
decisions.reason: Readable says whose appointment it is. That God set the time is implied by the word and the context.

decisions.choice: Wakati {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}
decisions.reason: The English "My time" begins the message and is capitalised either way, so it takes no span. Swahili puts the possessive after the noun ("wakati wangu"), so it takes the setting like any other "my" Jesus says of himself.

source.text: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὡς συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα.

records.literal_gloss: And did the disciples as directed them the Jesus and prepared the Passover.

en.L: And the disciples did as Jesus had directed them, and they prepared the Passover.
en.B: So the disciples followed Jesus's instructions and got the Passover meal ready.
en.R: The followers did what Jesus told them. They prepared the Passover meal.

es.L: E hicieron los discípulos como les había ordenado Jesús, y prepararon la Pascua.
es.B: Los discípulos siguieron las instrucciones de Jesús y prepararon la cena de la Pascua.
es.R: Los seguidores hicieron lo que Jesús les dijo. Prepararon la cena de la Pascua.

sw.L: Na wanafunzi wakatenda jinsi Yesu alivyowaelekeza, wakaitayarisha Pasaka.
sw.B: Basi wanafunzi walifuata maelekezo ya Yesu, wakaandaa chakula cha Pasaka.
sw.R: Wanafunzi walifanya yale Yesu aliyowaambia. Wakatayarisha chakula cha Pasaka.

decisions.choice: prepared the Passover: arranged the room, the lamb and the food
decisions.reason: The lamb had to be killed at the temple in the afternoon, and the unleavened bread, wine and herbs made ready.

source.text: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης ἀνέκειτο μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα μαθητῶν καὶ ἐσθιόντων αὐτῶν εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με.

records.literal_gloss: Evening and having come he was reclining with the twelve disciples. \v 21 And eating of them he said, Truly I say to you that one of you will hand over me.

en.L: Now when evening came, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was reclining [at table] with the twelve disciples. \v 21 And while they were eating, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Truly I tell you that one of you will betray {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: When evening came, Jesus took {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} place at the table with the twelve disciples. \v 21 During the meal {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Truly I tell you, one of you is going to betray {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: In the evening Jesus was at the table with the twelve followers. \v 21 While they were eating, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "I tell you the truth. One of you is going to turn against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and hand {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} over to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} enemies."

es.L: Llegada la tarde, estaba recostado [a la mesa] con los doce discípulos. \v 21 Y mientras ellos comían, dijo: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} entregará».
es.B: Al caer la tarde, Jesús se sentó a la mesa con los doce discípulos. \v 21 Durante la cena dijo: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} va a traicionar».
es.R: Por la tarde, Jesús estaba a la mesa con los doce seguidores. \v 21 Mientras comían, les dijo: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se va a volver contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} va a entregar a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} enemigos».

sw.L: Jioni ilipofika, alikuwa ameegemea [mezani] pamoja na wale wanafunzi kumi na wawili. \v 21 Na walipokuwa wakila, akasema, "Kweli nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanitoa."
sw.B: Ilipofika jioni, Yesu aliketi mezani pamoja na wanafunzi wale kumi na wawili. \v 21 Walipokuwa wakila, akasema, "Kweli nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti."
sw.R: Jioni Yesu alikuwa mezani pamoja na wanafunzi kumi na wawili. \v 21 Walipokuwa wakila, akasema, "Nawaambia ukweli: mmoja wenu atanigeuka na kunikabidhi kwa adui {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}."

decisions.choice: reclining: lying on couches around a low table, as at a feast
decisions.reason: At formal meals people reclined on their left side. At Passover even the poor reclined, as free people.

decisions.choice: betray: hand over to enemies
decisions.reason: The same verb as in 26:2 and 26:15. Coming from "one of you", the handing over is a betrayal.

decisions.choice: betray
decisions.reason: Where the verb is used of Judas's act, Literal and Balanced say "betray", as in 10:4.

decisions.choice: turn against me and hand me over to my enemies
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what betrayal means here.

decisions.choice: entregará (L); va a traicionar (B); se va a volver contra mí y me va a entregar (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is "hand over", here to enemies (meaning decision m2). Literal says "entregar" for it throughout the chapter, so the repeated word shows; Balanced says "traicionar" where the English says "betray"; Readable spells it out, as the English does. The same in 26:23-25.

decisions.choice: En verdad les digo (L, B); Les digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: The rendering of the single "amen" used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage; it covers 26:34 ("te digo", to Peter alone). Jesus speaks to the Twelve, so every plural "you" is the ustedes / vosotros setting.

decisions.choice: atanitoa (L); atanisaliti (B); atanigeuka na kunikabidhi (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is "hand over", here to enemies (meaning decision m2). Literal says "kutoa" for it throughout the chapter, so the repeated word shows; Balanced says "kusaliti" where the English says "betray"; Readable spells it out, as the English does. The same in 26:23-25.

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R)
decisions.reason: The rendering of the single "amen" used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage; it covers 26:34 ("nakuambia", to Peter alone).

source.text: καὶ λυπούμενοι σφόδρα ἤρξαντο λέγειν αὐτῷ εἷς ἕκαστος· Μήτι ἐγώ εἰμι, κύριε;

records.literal_gloss: And being grieved exceedingly they began to say to him each one, Not I am [it], Lord?

en.L: And being exceedingly grieved, they began to say to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, each one, "Surely it is not I, Lord?"
en.B: They were deeply upset, and one after another they began to ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Lord, it is not me, is it?"
en.R: The followers were very sad. One by one they asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Lord, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not mean me, do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?"

es.L: Y muy entristecidos, comenzaron a decirle cada uno: «¿Acaso soy yo, Señor?».
es.B: Ellos se pusieron muy tristes, y uno tras otro comenzaron a preguntarle: «Señor, no seré yo, ¿verdad?».
es.R: Los seguidores se pusieron muy tristes. Uno por uno {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron: «Señor, no estarás hablando de mí, ¿verdad?».

sw.L: Nao, wakiwa na huzuni nyingi mno, wakaanza kumwambia kila mmoja, "Hakika si mimi, Bwana?"
sw.B: Walisikitika sana, na mmoja baada ya mwingine wakaanza kumwuliza, "Bwana, si mimi, sivyo?"
sw.R: Wanafunzi walihuzunika sana. Kila mmoja akamwuliza, "Bwana, humaanishi mimi, sivyo?"

decisions.choice: surely not I: a question that expects the answer no
decisions.reason: The form of the question hopes for "no". Each is anxious, yet none is sure of himself.

decisions.choice: Lord: the disciples' address of faith
decisions.reason: The eleven say "Lord"; Judas says "Rabbi" (26:25).

decisions.choice: it is not me, is it? (B); you do not mean me, do you? (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use an English question that also expects no.

source.text: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν· Ὁ ἐμβάψας μετ’ ἐμοῦ τὴν χεῖρα ἐν τῷ τρυβλίῳ οὗτός με παραδώσει·

records.literal_gloss: He and answering said, The one having dipped with me the hand in the dish, this one me will hand over.

en.L: And answering, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "The [one] who has dipped the hand in the dish with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, he will betray {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: He replied, "Someone who has dipped his hand in the bowl along with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, he is the one who will betray {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: Jesus answered, "One of you who has eaten from the same bowl with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will hand {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} over.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, respondiendo, dijo: «El que mojó conmigo la mano en el plato, ese {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} entregará.
es.B: Él respondió: «Alguien que ha mojado la mano en el plato conmigo, ese es el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} va a traicionar.
es.R: Jesús respondió: «Uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que ha comido del mismo plato conmigo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} va a entregar.

sw.L: Naye akajibu, akasema, "Yeye aliyechovya mkono pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} katika bakuli, huyo ndiye atakayenitoa.
sw.B: Akajibu, "Mtu aliyechovya mkono wake katika bakuli pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}, huyo ndiye atakayenisaliti.
sw.R: Yesu akajibu, "Mmoja wenu ambaye amekula pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} katika bakuli moja atanikabidhi.

decisions.choice: the one who dipped with me: one who shares the meal, not a sign that points to one man
alternatives: a sign that names Judas to all
decisions.reason: Several shared each bowl. The words stress that the betrayer is a table companion, not that the others could tell who he was.

decisions.choice: betrayal by one who ate with him: Psalm 41:9
decisions.reason: The psalm speaks of a close friend who ate the singer's bread and turned against him. Eating together was a bond of trust.

decisions.choice: eaten from the same bowl
alternatives: dipped his hand in the dish
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what dipping in the dish means.

decisions.choice: conmigo, with no span
decisions.reason: "Conmigo" is one word, "with me", and is written plain, as in the rest of the Spanish; the "me" that is a separate word takes the span.

source.text: ὁ μὲν υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑπάγει καθὼς γέγραπται περὶ αὐτοῦ, οὐαὶ δὲ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ δι’ οὗ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται· καλὸν ἦν αὐτῷ εἰ οὐκ ἐγεννήθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος.

records.literal_gloss: The indeed Son of the Man goes as it is written about him, woe but to the man that through whom the Son of the Man is handed over; good were it for him if not was born the man that.

en.L: The Son of Man goes as it is written about {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be good for him if that man had not been born."
en.B: The Son of Man goes on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} way as the Scriptures have written of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, but woe to the one through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! Better for that man if he had never been born."
en.R: The Son of Man will die, just as the Scriptures say. But how terrible it will be for the man who hands over the Son of Man! It would be better for that man if he had never been born."

es.L: El Hijo del Hombre se va, como está escrito acerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, pero ¡ay de aquel hombre por medio del cual el Hijo del Hombre es entregado! Bueno sería para él si aquel hombre no hubiera nacido».
es.B: El Hijo del Hombre sigue {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} camino, tal como las Escrituras dicen de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; pero ¡ay de aquel por medio de quien el Hijo del Hombre es traicionado! Mejor habría sido para ese hombre no haber nacido nunca».
es.R: El Hijo del Hombre va a morir, tal como dicen las Escrituras. ¡Pero qué terrible será para el hombre que entrega al Hijo del Hombre! Para ese hombre habría sido mejor no nacer».

sw.L: Mwana wa Adamu anakwenda zake kama ilivyoandikwa kumhusu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, lakini ole wake mtu huyo ambaye kupitia kwake Mwana wa Adamu anatolewa! Lingekuwa jambo jema kwake, kama mtu huyo hangezaliwa."
sw.B: Mwana wa Adamu anakwenda njia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama Maandiko yalivyoandika juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, lakini ole wake yule ambaye Mwana wa Adamu anasalitiwa kupitia kwake! Ingekuwa afadhali kwa mtu huyo kama hangezaliwa kamwe."
sw.R: Mwana wa Adamu atakufa, kama Maandiko yanavyosema. Lakini mtu yule anayemkabidhi Mwana wa Adamu atapata taabu kubwa mno! Ingekuwa bora kwa mtu huyo kama hangezaliwa kabisa."

decisions.choice: goes as it is written: goes to his death, as the Scriptures say
decisions.reason: "Goes" is a way of speaking of death. Matthew does not name one passage here; compare 26:31, 54 and 56.

decisions.choice: God's plan and human guilt stand together
decisions.reason: That Scripture foretold the death does not lessen the guilt of the one who betrays him.

decisions.choice: better not born: his end will be worse than never having lived
decisions.reason: A strong saying of how terrible the judgment on the betrayer will be.

decisions.choice: will die, just as the Scriptures say
alternatives: goes as it is written about him
decisions.reason: Readable says what "goes" means here.

decisions.choice: how terrible it will be
decisions.reason: Readable explains the cry of woe; Literal and Balanced keep "woe", as in 11:21.

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν εἶπεν· Μήτι ἐγώ εἰμι, ῥαββί;

records.literal_gloss: Answering and Judas the one handing over him said, Not I am [it], rabbi?

en.L: And Judas, the [one] betraying {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, answered, "Surely it is not I, Rabbi?"
en.B: Then Judas, who was betraying {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, said, "Rabbi, it is not me, is it?"
en.R: Then Judas spoke. He was the one who was going to hand Jesus over. He said, "Teacher, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not mean me, do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?"

es.L: Y respondiendo Judas, el que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entregaba, dijo: «¿Acaso soy yo, Rabí?».
es.B: Entonces Judas, el que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} estaba traicionando, dijo: «Rabí, no seré yo, ¿verdad?».
es.R: Entonces habló Judas, el que iba a entregar a Jesús. Dijo: «Maestro, no estarás hablando de mí, ¿verdad?».

sw.L: Na Yuda, yule aliyekuwa akimtoa, akajibu, akasema, "Hakika si mimi, Rabi?"
sw.B: Kisha Yuda, aliyekuwa akimsaliti, akasema, "Rabi, si mimi, sivyo?"
sw.R: Kisha Yuda akazungumza. Yeye ndiye ambaye angemkabidhi Yesu. Akasema, "Mwalimu, humaanishi mimi, sivyo?"

decisions.choice: Rabbi: a title for a teacher, "my teacher"
decisions.reason: In Matthew only Judas calls Jesus "Rabbi" (here and 26:49), while the others say "Lord" (26:22). Jesus had told his disciples not to seek that title (23:7-8).

decisions.choice: Teacher
decisions.reason: Readable gives the meaning of the title.

records.literal_gloss: He says to him, You said.

en.L: He says to him, "You have said [so]."
en.B: Jesus told him, "You have said it yourself."
en.R: Jesus said to him, "You have said it yourself."

es.B: Jesús le respondió: «Tú mismo lo has dicho».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «Tú mismo lo has dicho».

decisions.choice: you have said so: yes, but in your words, not mine
decisions.reason: The phrase agrees with what was asked while putting the words back on the speaker. Here it tells Judas that Jesus knows. Jesus answers the high priest the same way in 26:64.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: yourself
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the stress on "you" in the Greek.

source.text: Ἐσθιόντων δὲ αὐτῶν λαβὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἄρτον καὶ εὐλογήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ δοὺς τοῖς μαθηταῖς εἶπεν· Λάβετε φάγετε, τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου.

records.literal_gloss: Eating and of them, having taken the Jesus bread and having blessed broke and having given to the disciples said, Take, eat, this is the body of me.

en.L: And while they were eating, Jesus took bread, and after blessing [it] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} broke [it], and giving [it] to the disciples, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Take, eat; this is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} body."
en.B: During the meal Jesus took a loaf, said the blessing, and broke it. He gave it to the disciples and said, "Take it and eat. This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} body."
en.R: While they were eating, Jesus took some bread. He thanked God for it and broke it into pieces. He gave it to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers and said, "Take this and eat it. This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} body."

es.L: Y mientras ellos comían, Jesús tomó pan y, habiendo pronunciado la bendición, [lo] partió y, dándo[lo] a los discípulos, dijo: «{{plural_you:Tomen|Tomad}}, {{plural_you:coman|comed}}; esto es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cuerpo».
es.B: Durante la cena, Jesús tomó un pan, pronunció la bendición y lo partió. Se lo dio a los discípulos y dijo: «{{plural_you:Tómenlo|Tomadlo}} y {{plural_you:coman|comed}}. Esto es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cuerpo».
es.R: Mientras comían, Jesús tomó pan. Le dio gracias a Dios por él y lo partió en pedazos. Se lo dio a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} seguidores y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Tomen|Tomad}} esto y {{plural_you:cómanlo|comedlo}}. Esto es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cuerpo».

sw.L: Na walipokuwa wakila, Yesu akachukua mkate, na akiisha kusema baraka akaumega, na alipokuwa akiwapa wanafunzi akasema, "Chukueni, mle; huu ni mwili {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."
sw.B: Walipokuwa wakila, Yesu alichukua mkate, akasema maneno ya baraka, akaumega. Akawapa wanafunzi, akasema, "Chukueni mle. Huu ni mwili {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."
sw.R: Walipokuwa wakila, Yesu alichukua mkate. Akamshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yake, akaumega vipande vipande. Akawapa wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akasema, "Chukueni mkate huu mle. Huu ni mwili {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."

decisions.choice: blessed: praised God over the bread, as at every Jewish meal
decisions.reason: The head of the meal said a blessing to God before breaking bread, as Jesus did when he fed the crowds (14:19). The cup is introduced with "giving thanks" (26:27).

decisions.choice: this is my body: the broken bread is his body given in death
alternatives: only a sign with no further meaning
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks at the Passover, where the food told of God's saving acts (Exodus 12:26-27). Christians have long differed over how the bread is his body; the words themselves say "is".

decisions.choice: thanked God for it
decisions.reason: Readable says to whom the blessing was spoken.

decisions.choice: Chukueni
decisions.reason: "Kuchukua" is the everyday verb for "take"; "kutwaa" is older and literary. The plain verb suits a meal at which Jesus hands bread to his friends.

source.text: καὶ λαβὼν ποτήριον καὶ εὐχαριστήσας ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων· Πίετε ἐξ αὐτοῦ πάντες, τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν τὸ αἷμά μου τῆς διαθήκης τὸ περὶ πολλῶν ἐκχυννόμενον εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν·

records.literal_gloss: And having taken a cup and having given thanks he gave to them saying, Drink from it all, \v 28 this for is the blood of me of the covenant the for many being poured out for forgiveness of sins.

en.L: And taking a cup and giving thanks, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave [it] to them, saying, "Drink from it, all [of you], \v 28 for this is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for [the] forgiveness of sins.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took a cup, gave thanks, and passed it to them, saying, "Every one of you, drink from it. \v 28 For this is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant blood, poured out for many to bring forgiveness of sins.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took a cup of wine and thanked God for it. He gave it to them and said, "All of you drink from this cup. \v 28 This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} blood, which makes the covenant, God's agreement with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. It is poured out for many people, so that their sins can be forgiven.

es.L: Y tomando una copa y dando gracias, les [la] dio, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Beban|Bebed}} todos de ella, \v 28 pues esto es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sangre del pacto, derramada por muchos para el perdón de los pecados.
es.B: Luego tomó una copa, dio gracias y se la pasó, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Beban|Bebed}} de ella, cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \v 28 Porque esto es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sangre, la sangre del pacto, que se derrama por muchos para traer el perdón de los pecados.
es.R: Después tomó una copa de vino y le dio gracias a Dios por ella. Se la dio a ellos y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Beban|Bebed}} todos de esta copa. \v 28 Esta es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sangre, que establece el pacto, el acuerdo de Dios con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. Se derrama por mucha gente, para que sus pecados puedan ser perdonados.

sw.L: Na alipochukua kikombe na kutoa shukrani, akawapa, akisema, "Nyweni kutoka humo, ninyi nyote, \v 28 kwa maana hii ni damu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ya agano, inayomiminwa kwa ajili ya wengi kwa msamaha wa dhambi.
sw.B: Kisha akachukua kikombe, akatoa shukrani, akawapa, akisema, "Kila mmoja wenu anywe kutoka humo. \v 28 Kwa maana hii ni damu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ya agano, inayomiminwa kwa ajili ya wengi ili dhambi zisamehewe.
sw.R: Kisha akachukua kikombe cha divai, akamshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yake. Akawapa, akasema, "Nyote nyweni kutoka katika kikombe hiki. \v 28 Hii ni damu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, inayoweka agano, yaani mapatano ya Mungu na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Inamiminwa kwa ajili ya watu wengi, ili dhambi zao zisamehewe.

decisions.choice: my blood of the covenant: Exodus 24:8
decisions.reason: At Sinai Moses sprinkled the people with blood and said, "See the blood of the covenant." Jesus's death seals a covenant in the same way. Jeremiah 31:31-34 promised a new covenant with forgiveness of sins.

decisions.choice: the covenant, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: the new covenant, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "the new covenant", probably from Luke 22:20 and 1 Corinthians 11:25. Several early manuscripts lack "new". Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: poured out for many: Isaiah 53:12
decisions.reason: The servant "poured out his life to death" and "bore the sin of many". "Many" means a great number, as in 20:28.

decisions.choice: for the forgiveness of sins: his death brings forgiveness
decisions.reason: The angel said he would save his people from their sins (1:21). Here Jesus says how.

decisions.choice: a cup of wine; which makes the covenant, God's agreement with his people
decisions.reason: Readable says what was in the cup and what a covenant is.

decisions.choice: pacto
decisions.reason: The word used for the covenant in the Spanish of Hebrews and Galatians, so that this verse and the covenant passages of Hebrews 8-9 read alike (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: msamaha wa dhambi
decisions.reason: "Msamaha" is the everyday word for forgiveness and is used at every level (Balanced and Readable say "ili dhambi zisamehewe"); "ondoleo" is older and less familiar.

source.text: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ πίω ἀπ’ ἄρτι ἐκ τούτου τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ὅταν αὐτὸ πίνω μεθ’ ὑμῶν καινὸν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ πατρός μου.

records.literal_gloss: I say but to you, not not I will drink from now of this the fruit of the vine until the day that when it I drink with you new in the kingdom of the Father of me.

en.L: But I tell you, I will by no means drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it new with you in the kingdom of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father."
en.B: But I tell you this: from now on I will not drink this fruit of the vine again until the day comes when I share it with you, new, in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father's kingdom."
en.R: I tell you, I will not drink wine again until the day when I drink it with you in a new way in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father's kingdom."

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que de ningún modo volveré a beber, desde ahora, de este producto de la vid, hasta aquel día en que lo beba nuevo con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en el reino de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre».
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:les|os}} digo esto: desde ahora no volveré a beber de este fruto de la vid hasta el día en que lo comparta nuevo con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en el reino de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que no volveré a beber vino hasta el día en que lo beba con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} de una manera nueva en el reino de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre».

sw.L: Lakini nawaambia, kuanzia sasa sitakunywa kamwe zao hili la mzabibu, mpaka siku ile nitakapolinywa likiwa jipya pamoja nanyi katika ufalme wa Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}."
sw.B: Lakini nawaambia hivi: tangu sasa sitakunywa tena zao hili la mzabibu mpaka siku ile nitakaposhiriki nanyi, likiwa jipya, katika ufalme wa Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}."
sw.R: Nawaambia, sitakunywa divai tena mpaka siku ile nitakapoinywa pamoja nanyi kwa namna mpya katika ufalme wa Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}."

decisions.choice: the fruit of the vine: wine
decisions.reason: The phrase was used in the Jewish blessing spoken over wine.

decisions.choice: new: of a new kind, belonging to the age to come
decisions.reason: The word means new in quality. Jesus looks ahead to the feast of the kingdom (8:11; Isaiah 25:6).

decisions.choice: wine; in a new way
alternatives: this fruit of the vine; new
decisions.reason: Readable says what the phrase means and how "new" applies.

decisions.choice: producto de la vid (L); fruto de la vid (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is "what is produced", the yield of the vine (meaning decision m1). Literal says "producto"; Balanced uses the familiar "fruto"; Readable says "vino", as the English does.

decisions.choice: zao hili la mzabibu
decisions.reason: "Zao" is a crop or yield, the sense of the Greek word, the drink the vine produces (meaning decision m1). Readable says "divai" (wine), as the English does.

source.text: καὶ ὑμνήσαντες ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸ Ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And having sung a hymn they went out to the Mount of the Olives.

en.L: And after singing a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
en.B: Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives.
en.R: They sang a song of praise. Then they went out to the Mount of Olives.

es.L: Y después de cantar un himno, salieron al monte de los Olivos.
es.B: Luego cantaron un himno y salieron hacia el monte de los Olivos.
es.R: Cantaron un canto de alabanza. Después salieron hacia el monte de los Olivos.

sw.L: Na baada ya kuimba wimbo, walitoka kwenda Mlima wa Mizeituni.
sw.B: Kisha waliimba wimbo, wakatoka kwenda Mlima wa Mizeituni.
sw.R: Waliimba wimbo wa kumsifu Mungu. Kisha wakatoka, wakaenda Mlima wa Mizeituni.

decisions.choice: a hymn: probably the psalms that closed the Passover meal
decisions.reason: Later Jewish practice sang Psalms 113-118 at Passover, ending with the last of them after the meal. Matthew does not say which song was sung.

decisions.choice: the Mount of Olives: the ridge east of Jerusalem
alternatives: a hill far from the city
decisions.reason: It lay across the Kidron Valley from the temple (21:1; 24:3).

decisions.choice: a song of praise
decisions.reason: Readable uses plainer words.

source.text: Τότε λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Πάντες ὑμεῖς σκανδαλισθήσεσθε ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ταύτῃ, γέγραπται γάρ· Πατάξω τὸν ποιμένα, καὶ διασκορπισθήσονται τὰ πρόβατα τῆς ποίμνης·

records.literal_gloss: Then says to them the Jesus, All you will be caused to stumble in me in the night this; it is written for, I will strike the shepherd, and will be scattered the sheep of the flock.

en.L: Then Jesus says to them, "All of you will fall away because of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} this night, for it is written, 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.'
en.B: Then Jesus told them, "This very night every one of you will fall away because of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. For it is written: 'I will strike down the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will scatter in all directions.'
en.R: Then Jesus said to them, "Tonight all of you will turn away and leave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. In the Scriptures God says, 'I will strike down the shepherd, and the sheep will run off in every direction.'

es.L: Entonces les dice Jesús: «Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:tropezarán|tropezaréis}} por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} esta noche, porque está escrito: “Golpearé al pastor, y se dispersarán las ovejas del rebaño”.
es.B: Entonces Jesús les dijo: «Esta misma noche todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:se apartarán|os apartaréis}} por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Porque está escrito: “Derribaré al pastor, y las ovejas del rebaño se dispersarán en todas direcciones”.
es.R: Entonces Jesús les dijo: «Esta noche todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:se van a alejar|os vais a alejar}} de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dejarán|dejaréis}} solo. En las Escrituras Dios dice: “Derribaré al pastor, y las ovejas huirán en todas direcciones”.

sw.L: Kisha Yesu anawaambia, "Ninyi nyote mtajikwaa kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} usiku huu, kwa maana imeandikwa, 'Nitampiga mchungaji, na kondoo wa kundi lake watasambazwa.'
sw.B: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, "Usiku huu huu ninyi nyote mtakwazika kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, mkaniacha. Kwa maana imeandikwa, 'Nitamwangusha mchungaji, na kondoo wa kundi watasambaa kila upande.'
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, "Usiku wa leo ninyi nyote mtageuka na kuniacha. Katika Maandiko Mungu anasema, 'Nitamwangusha mchungaji, na kondoo watakimbia kila upande.'

decisions.choice: fall away: stumble and desert him
decisions.reason: The verb pictures tripping over an obstacle (11:6; 13:21). That night they will abandon him (26:56).

decisions.choice: I will strike the shepherd: Zechariah 13:7
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew, God commands his sword to strike the shepherd. In Matthew's wording God himself says "I will strike". The "I" is God speaking.

decisions.choice: the shepherd and the sheep: Jesus and his disciples
decisions.reason: Jesus is the shepherd of God's people (2:6; 9:36). When he is struck, his followers scatter.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: In the Scriptures God says
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker of the quoted words, as meaning decision m2 explains.

decisions.choice: tropezarán (L); se apartarán (B); se van a alejar ... y me dejarán solo (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is "be made to stumble": here, to falter and desert Jesus (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the picture; Balanced says "apartarse", the sense of the English "fall away"; Readable says what they will do. "Escandalizarse" now means to be shocked, which is not the sense. The same verbs in 26:33.

decisions.choice: mtajikwaa (L); mtakwazika ... mkaniacha (B); mtageuka na kuniacha (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is "be made to stumble": here, to falter and desert Jesus (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the picture ("kujikwaa", to stumble); Balanced says "kukwazika" (to be made to fall) and adds that they will leave him, as the English "fall away" means; Readable says what they will do. The same verbs in 26:33.

source.text: μετὰ δὲ τὸ ἐγερθῆναί με προάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

records.literal_gloss: After but the being raised me I will go before you into the Galilee.

en.L: But after I am raised, I will go ahead of you into Galilee."
en.B: But after I have been raised, I will go to Galilee ahead of you."
en.R: But after God raises {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} from death, I will go to Galilee ahead of you."

es.L: Pero después de ser yo resucitado, iré delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a Galilea».
es.B: Pero después de haber sido resucitado, iré a Galilea antes que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».
es.R: Pero después de que Dios {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} resucite de la muerte, iré a Galilea antes que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».

sw.L: Lakini baada ya {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} kufufuliwa, nitawatangulia mpaka Galilaya."
sw.B: Lakini baada ya kufufuliwa, nitatangulia mbele yenu kwenda Galilaya."
sw.R: Lakini baada ya Mungu kunifufua kutoka kwa wafu, nitatangulia kwenda Galilaya kabla yenu."

decisions.choice: after I am raised: God will raise him
alternatives: after I rise by my own power
decisions.reason: The passive points to God as the one who acts (16:21; 17:23).

decisions.choice: go ahead of you: lead them, like a shepherd going before the flock
decisions.reason: After the scattering, the shepherd will gather them again. The promise is repeated in 28:7, 10 and kept in 28:16.

decisions.choice: God raises me from death
decisions.reason: Readable names the one who raises him.

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Εἰ πάντες σκανδαλισθήσονται ἐν σοί, ἐγὼ οὐδέποτε σκανδαλισθήσομαι.

records.literal_gloss: Answering and the Peter said to him, If all will be caused to stumble in you, I never will be caused to stumble.

en.L: But Peter answered and said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "If all fall away because of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, I will never fall away."
en.B: Peter answered, "The others may all fall away because of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, but I will never fall away."
en.R: Peter said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "All the others may turn away from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. But I will never do that!"

es.L: Y respondiendo Pedro, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «Si todos tropiezan por causa de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, yo jamás tropezaré».
es.B: Pedro {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} respondió: «Aunque todos los demás se aparten por causa de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, yo jamás me apartaré».
es.R: Pedro {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «Puede que todos los demás se alejen de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. ¡Pero yo nunca haré eso!».

sw.L: Lakini Petro akamjibu, akasema, "Hata kama wote watajikwaa kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, mimi sitajikwaa kamwe."
sw.B: Petro akamjibu, "Hata kama wengine wote watakwazika kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, mimi sitakwazika kamwe."
sw.R: Petro akamwambia, "Huenda wengine wote wakakugeuka na kukuacha. Lakini mimi sitafanya hivyo kamwe!"

decisions.choice: if all fall away, I never will: Peter sets himself above the others
decisions.reason: The "I" is stressed. Peter's boast prepares for his threefold denial (26:69-75).

source.text: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρὶς ἀπαρνήσῃ με.

records.literal_gloss: Said to him the Jesus, Truly I say to you that in this the night before rooster to crow three times you will deny me.

en.L: Jesus said to him, "Truly I tell you that this night, before a rooster crows, you will deny {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} three times."
en.B: Jesus told him, "Truly I tell you, three times this very night you will deny {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, before a rooster crows."
en.R: Jesus said to him, "I tell you the truth. Tonight, before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: Jesús le dijo: «En verdad te digo que en esta noche, antes de que un gallo cante, tres veces {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} negarás».
es.B: Jesús le respondió: «En verdad te digo que esta misma noche, antes de que cante un gallo, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} vas a negar tres veces».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «Te digo la verdad: esta noche, antes de que cante el gallo, vas a decir tres veces que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conoces».

sw.L: Yesu akamwambia, "Kweli nakuambia kwamba katika usiku huu, kabla ya jogoo kuwika, mara tatu utanikana."
sw.B: Yesu akamwambia, "Kweli nakuambia, usiku huu huu utanikana mara tatu, kabla jogoo hajawika."
sw.R: Yesu akamwambia, "Nakuambia ukweli: usiku wa leo, kabla jogoo hajawika, utasema mara tatu kwamba hunijui."

decisions.choice: before a rooster crows: before dawn
decisions.reason: Roosters crow in the last hours of the night. Mark 13:35 names "cockcrow" among the watches of the night.

decisions.choice: deny me: disown me, say you do not know me
decisions.reason: As in 10:33. Peter's words in 26:70, 72 and 74 are exactly this.

decisions.choice: say that you do not know me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the denial will be.

source.text: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος· Κἂν δέῃ με σὺν σοὶ ἀποθανεῖν, οὐ μή σε ἀπαρνήσομαι.

records.literal_gloss: Says to him the Peter, Even if it is necessary me with you to die, not not you I will deny.

en.L: Peter says to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Even if I must die with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, I will by no means deny {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.B: But Peter insisted, "I will never deny {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, not even if it means dying with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!"
en.R: Peter said, "I will never say I do not know {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! I will even die with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} if I have to!"

es.L: Le dice Pedro: «Incluso si debo morir contigo, de ningún modo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} negaré».
es.B: Pero Pedro insistió: «¡Jamás {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} negaré, aunque tenga que morir contigo!».
es.R: Pedro dijo: «¡Yo nunca diré que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} conozco! ¡Hasta moriré contigo si hace falta!».

sw.L: Petro anamwambia, "Hata ikinipasa kufa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}, hakika sitakukana."
sw.B: Lakini Petro akasisitiza, "Sitakukana kamwe, hata ikibidi nife pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}!"
sw.R: Petro akasema, "Sitasema kamwe kwamba sikujui! Nitakufa hata pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} ikibidi!"

decisions.choice: by no means: the strongest form of denial
decisions.reason: Peter uses the double negative that Jesus used in 26:29.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: the promise first, the condition after
alternatives: Even if I must die with you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put Peter's vow first for force.

source.text: ὁμοίως καὶ πάντες οἱ μαθηταὶ εἶπαν.

records.literal_gloss: Likewise also all the disciples said.

en.L: Likewise all the disciples also said [so].
en.B: Every one of the disciples said the same.
en.R: All the other followers said the same thing.

es.L: Del mismo modo dijeron también todos los discípulos.
es.B: Y todos los discípulos dijeron lo mismo.
es.R: Todos los demás seguidores dijeron lo mismo.

sw.L: Na vivyo hivyo wanafunzi wote pia walisema.
sw.B: Kila mmoja wa wanafunzi alisema hivyo hivyo.
sw.R: Wanafunzi wengine wote nao walisema maneno hayo hayo.

decisions.choice: all the disciples: the same "all" who will flee
decisions.reason: Compare 26:56: "all the disciples left him and fled."
